svg.title: Aditya K. Koundinya, product portfolio: AI Product and Product Analytics. Computer Science graduate and NextLeap Product Management Fellow. I build AI products end to end: grounded in real sources, with guardrails in front of the model, and designed to stay quiet when the evidence is thin. Before that, I turned manufacturing data into decisions at Bosch. Open to Associate Product Manager, Product Analyst, AI Product, Product Operations, Business Analyst and Growth Analytics roles. The animation shows the six step product loop every project goes through: Problem, Users, Insights, Product, Metrics, Iteration. A loop, not a launch.
